and 62–85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists
on long-horizon tasks).

An effective agent policy language must thus bestateful:
what an agent is permitted to do next must depend not only
on the task prompt, but also on its prior actions and observed
data. A stateful policy can express exact constraints for this
example: the agent must first list_transactions, and then
send_money only to a sender and for an amount appearing
in the past week’s transactions. Sapien contributes such a
stateful policy language, together with a runtime engine that
generates and enforces policies as the agent executes.

jectories (hence the remaining gap in Figure 1): defining
appropriateness can depend on natural-language semantics
that resist exact specification, such as whether an email body
faithfully summarizes a document. (Sapien addresses this
gap in a best-effort manner via scoped AI judges—see §4.4.)
Nevertheless, statefulness allows for much tighter policies
than stateless alternatives and is essential to blocking the
worst outcomes in practical tasks.

achieve this, Sapien interposes on the agent’s harness to
mediate between the agent and its tools.

6.2 Security
Under our analytical model, a hijacked agent can issue any
sequence of tool calls admitted by the policy, so NoPolicy
blocks 0% of attacks. AllowList blocks an attack only when
the attacker’s goal requires a tool the user’s task does not
need at all, and may permit attacks that abuse a required tool.
Sapien closes this gap with fine-grained, stateful constraints.
On AgentDojo (Figure 7), Sapien blocks 93.2–95.2% of
the 949 attack instances depending on the model, against
82.7–86.8% for AllowList. On Toolathlon (Figure 8), where
the attacker goals target tools the user task requires, Sapien
blocks 64.6% of the 212 attack instances on the full suite
with Gemini 3.8 Flash (against 32.4% for AllowList), and
62.5–85.0% of the 40 instances on the 20-task subset across
the four models (against 22.5–35.0% for AllowList). Across
both benchmarks, attacks that succeed under Sapien fall into
